name: instagram_dm-mcp
description: Instagram DM (messaging): me, list_inbound, get_thread, send. Every tool maps to a documented endpoi

platform_mcp_instagram_dm_page_access_to.title: PLATFORM_MCP_INSTAGRAM_DM_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_instagram_dm_page_access_to.description: Page access token of the Facebook Page linked to the Instagram professional account, requested by a person who can perform the MESSAGE task on that Page, with instagram_basic, instagram_manage_messages and pages_manage_metadata (Messenger Platform > Instagram Messaging, https://developers.facebook.com/docs/messenger-platform/instagram/features/send-message); sent as `Authorization: Bearer`.

platform_mcp_instagram_dm_page_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_INSTAGRAM_DM_PAGE_ID
platform_mcp_instagram_dm_page_id.description: Numeric id of the Facebook Page linked to the Instagram professional account; conversations are listed with /<page_id>/conversations?platform=instagram and messages sent with /<page_id>/messages. Env: PLATFORM_MCP_INSTAGRAM_DM_PAGE_ID.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /{page_id}?fields=id,name,instagram_business_account: the Facebook Page linked to the Instagram professional account and the linked IG account id.

tools.name: list_inbound
tools.description: GET /{page_id}/conversations?platform=instagram with field expansion messages.limit(1){...}: one row per conversation carrying its most recent message (which may be the Page's own outbound message - compare from_id with the Page / account id). thread_id is the conversation id for get_thread; from_id is the Instagram-scoped id (IGSID) for send. 'Conversations that are within the Requests folder that have not been active for 30 days will not be returned'. `since`/`channel` are not sent; cursor paging, so `page` is ignored.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: GET /{conversation_id}/messages?fields=id,message,from,to,created_time (newest first). 'you can only get details about the 20 most recent messages in the conversation' (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/messenger-platform/conversations), so limit is capped at 20.

tools.name: send
tools.description: POST /{page_id}/messages {recipient: {id: IGSID}, message: {text}} answers {recipient_id, message_id}. `to` must be the Instagram-scoped ID of a person who messaged the account (list_inbound from_id); 'Text message must be less than 1,000 characters'; 'Apps with Standard Access can only send messages to people that have a role on the app'. `subject`/`channel` are ignored.
